subject: Mosaic MAP & Sprint Ownership — proposed timeline and acceptance gates
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mosaic MAP & Sprint Ownership — proposed timeline and acceptance gates

Alex — good to connect yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass "Mosaic" mutual action plan that ties milestones to sprint-level owners and explicit acceptance gates. High level asks in this email: 1) confirm the three sprint windows below (we used your target launch in June), 2) confirm ownership on the Acceptance Criteria column, and 3) highlight any compliance evidence you need earlier in the plan.

Summary (proposed):
- Sprint A (Integration & Ingest): 2028-04-02 to 2028-04-16 — tasks: SSO + VPC peering, ingest pipeline baseline, test dataset upload. Owners: Engineering (Redwood), Horizon data team. Acceptance gate: successful end-to-end ingest of 10k records and tokenized sample audit.
- Sprint B (Model Pinning & Latency Tuning): 2028-04-17 to 2028-05-07 — tasks: model variants pinned, quantization profile validated, latency benchmark <120ms p95. Owners: Redwood infra, Horizon Platform. Acceptance gate: p95 latency verified for 512-token sequences.
- Sprint C (Canary & Rollout): 2028-05-08 to 2028-06-01 — tasks: canary traffic, fallback routing, cost thresholds configured. Owners: CS + Platform Ops. Acceptance gate: canary stability for 72 hours at 5% traffic, SLOs met.

Key dependencies and early asks:
- Procurement: SOW sign by 2028-04-01 (we attached draft).
- Security: SOC2 evidence and network diagram requested by 2028-04-05.
- Dedicated capacity: capacity lock (GPU pool sizing) by 2028-04-10.

I've attached Mosaic-MAP-v1.xlsx with the full milestone roster and an initial risk register. Please review and reply with edits; we'll move to a tracked version on your shared Drive once we align. If these sprint dates look tight, propose alternate end-dates per sprint and we'll rework owners.

Thanks — I blocked a 30m slot next Tue afternoon for a quick alignment if that helps.

--
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment(s): Mosaic-MAP-v1.xlsx, SOW-draft-HorizonAI.docx

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic MAP & Sprint Ownership — proposed timeline and acceptance gates

Karthik — thanks for the detailed plan and for walking us through it. Overall this looks good; a couple of quick notes from our side after internal sync: 1) Procurement needs the SOW to reflect a 45-day invoice term and our standard IP language (we'll send redlines), 2) Security asked that the initial evidence bundle include the network diagram and our encryption walkthrough before ingest (can we move that to 2028-04-03?), and 3) the latency target is fine but we need a separate row in the MAP for the 95th percentile for short-form (<=128 tokens) and long-form (>=512 tokens) so both are tracked independently.

On dates — we are comfortable with Sprint A starting 2028-04-02 but would like Sprint B to begin 2028-04-24 to give our infra team an extra week for the ingest hardening. That shifts the overall go-live toward mid-June; can Redwood confirm availability for the dedicated pool the week of 2028-05-15 if we move the dates?

I'll attach Procurement redlines shortly.

Best,
Alex
Head of Platform Integrations, Horizon AI
ale x.chen@horizonai.com | +1 617-555-0147

On Wed, Mar 22, 2028 at 9:12 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — good to connect yesterday. As promised, attached is a first-pass "Mosaic" mutual action plan...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Mar 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic MAP & Sprint Ownership — proposed timeline and acceptance gates

Alex — appreciate the quick review and Procurement note. A few clarifications from CS/Implementation so we have clear, testable acceptance gates: 

Sprint A acceptance (ingest):
- Upload of 10k sample file to the ingest bucket and successful parsing run without >1% errors.
- End-to-end traceability: each record must have request-id and be replayable into a staging copy.
- Security checkpoint: basic network diagram and encryption walkthrough delivered to Horizon security inbox.

Sprint B acceptance (model/latency):
- Benchmarks produced for both short-form (<=128 tokens) and long-form (>=512 tokens) with p50/p95 stats.
- Quantization profile validated on your representative dataset with no >5% quality regression on the provided prompt set.

Sprint C acceptance (canary):
- Canary at 5% for 72 hours with no errors >0.5% and CPU/GPU utilization stable.

Resource notes:
- I'll assign an implementation lead (Marissa) and a solutions engineer (Dylan) — they will run weekly stand-ups and own cutover checklists.
- Lauren will handle post-go-live adoption metrics and the success criteria for the first 30/60/90 days.

If Horizon moves Sprint B to 2028-04-24 that's fine; please confirm by Monday so we can reserve the dedicated pool for the week of 2028-05-15 as requested.

Thanks,
Marissa
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment(s): implementation-risk-register.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP: revised sprint dates and procurement next steps

Alex / team — thanks for the redlines (Procurement received them), and thanks Marissa for clarifying acceptance gates. We've updated the attached Mosaic-MAP-v1.1.xlsx and SOW-draft-HorizonAI.docx to reflect: 
- Sprint B start moved to 2028-04-24, Sprint B end 2028-05-14, Sprint C start 2028-05-15, canary window 2028-05-15 to 2028-06-05.
- Security evidence milestone moved to 2028-04-03 as requested.
- Separate latency rows added for short/long form with targets: short-form p95 <80ms, long-form p95 <140ms.

Procurement asks:
- Please confirm SOW redlines by 2028-03-30 so Finance can process the initial order and we can lock capacity by 2028-04-10.

Action items (owner / due):
- Horizon procurement: deliver SOW redlines (Alex / procurement@horizonai.com) — due 2028-03-30.
- Redwood: reserve dedicated GPU pool tentative week of 2028-05-15 (Karthik) — will confirm by 2028-04-04.
- Security evidence: Horizon to receive diagram and walkthrough (Marissa to deliver) — due 2028-04-03.

I've also created a short Jira ticket to track the capacity lock: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-8331 (links in the attached MAP). Let's use the Tue 3pm PT slot next week for a short cadence sync if that works for everyone.

Regards,
Karthik
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Mosaic-MAP-v1.1.xlsx, SOW-draft-HorizonAI.docx

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@horizonai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Karthik / Marissa — this looks good and thanks for moving the security milestone up. Procurement will return SOW redlines today (you should see an email from procurement@horizonai.com). We confirm the tentative capacity week of 2028-05-15 — please change tentative to locked once you hear back from Finance on Redwood's side.

Quick confirmation on acceptance gates: we agree to the separate latency rows and the ingest acceptance criteria as written. Once SOW is signed we'll set a firm kickoff for 2028-04-02 and loop in our platform on-call for the first two sprints.

Confirming: Procurement redlines coming 3/28; Horizon signs off on the MAP acceptance gates. Proceed to lock capacity pending Finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform Integrations, Horizon AI
